<!-- pr-reviewer: 30479ed7b47c6b7e239e540a414296fe195aa1aa -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks @tbrasselle - a tidy, well-scoped first contribution.

**What looks good**
- `Camera.projection: ProjectionMode` (Perspective default) rides the camera, so `mvp`, `ray_through` and `dolly_cursor` branch on the same field; `frame`/`toward`/`oriented` and `State::frame` carry it (viewport.rs ~1071-1330, state.rs ~3285-3305).
- Ortho half-height `dist*tan(30deg)` matches perspective at the target plane, so the toggle never jumps the framing. Depth is linear with near 0.1 / far `max(dist*40, 1000)`, same planes as perspective. Pick rays are parallel through the same box and finite/degenerate checks refuse bad math (returns None).
- View state only: a direct field flip (`actions::toggle_projection`, radios in the browser, bare P guarded like F so Ctrl+P keeps the post dialog); not saved in the project, so no command or format bump is needed. No unwrap/expect/panic added outside tests.
- Pinning tests cover matrix affinity, parallel rays + cursor closure, dolly fixed point and carry-through; shell tests for the radios and bare P.
- Snapshots: the three PNGs differ only by the new "Projection" row; the toolbar badge still reads "v0.0.0".

**Local results** (PR head, CWD crates/ui, own target dir)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- viewport camera ortho law vertex_pick egui_shell_snapshot tool_editor_snapshot projection bare_p`: 76 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test trace_composite`: 4 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean
- `gpu_render` not run (needs a GPU adapter; its edit is only `..Camera::default()`).
- Trial merge with current origin/main is textually clean (no conflicts), but I could not build the merged tree: **origin/main itself currently fails to compile** in `crates/app/src/warned_moves.rs:23` (E0004, `Warning::HolderHit` not covered) - unrelated to this PR, which touches no `crates/app` files. I tested the PR head instead.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- In the browser pane the "Ortho" radio label is clipped to "Orth" at the default pane width (visible in the snapshot); a shorter label or wrapping the row would fix it.
- viewport.rs (~1400 lines) and state.rs are already far over the 400-line guide; this PR adds modestly to them, not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
